name: SAML Authentication
description: Allows users to authenticate against an external SAML identity provider.

suggests.drupal/key: Safer retrieval of the SP private key / certificate (e.g. from an environment variable).
suggests.drupal/flood_control: Administrative UI over the flood-based failed-login protection.
suggests.drupal/views: Admin list of authmap links (SAML login ↔ Drupal user) with a delete UI.

project_description:
This modules allows users to authenticate against a SAML Identity Provider to log in to your Drupal site. (This means your Drupal site serves as a SAML Service Provider.)

 Documentation 
 The README contains installation instructions, more information about SAML communication, handling of user info, security considerations and more.

 A list of all modules with a similar function and a broader overview of SAML use cases in Drupal are available in the Contributed Modules documentation section.

 Support status 
 The main module functionality is stable. Maintenance is lagging (because volunteer driven), but this is not known to affect the majority of projects using it. 

 In case of needs that go beyond anything that should be handled in the issue queue: feel free to send the main maintainer a message.

 As of 2025: 7.x releases have been removed from the project page, but there still is some level of support for 7.x-1.x issues in this issue queue, per D7Security group practices.

 Related functionality / extension modules 
 Support for multiple IdPs 
 The SAML auth Multi IDP module provides an implementation. Feedback about this solution

vs. any work (still / not anymore) needed in this module, is welcome in the related samlauth issue .

 Migrating from simplesamlphp_auth 
 See the dedicated module , and possibly the related samlauth issue .
